title.zh: 在大马尼拉 Valenzuela 市将 Canumay 附属校从该市市镇中学分离，设立 Canumay 国立中学并为其提供经费
title.en: An Act Creating the Canumay National High School in Valenzuela, Metro Manila, By Separating the Canumay Annex From the Valenzuela Municipal High School, and Providing Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Creating the Canumay National High School in Valenzuela, Metro Manila, By Separating the Canumay Annex From the Valenzuela Municipal High School, and Providing Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8391_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Canumay Annex of Valenzuela Municipal High School located in Barangay Canumay, Municipality of Valenzuela, Metro Manila, is hereby separated from the said Valenzuela Municipal High School and thereafter created as an independent educational institution, to be known as the Canumay National High School.
All properties and assets presently pertaining or belonging to the Valenzuela Municipal High School – Canumay Annex are hereby transferred to the newly created Canumay National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Valenzuela Municipal High School - Canumay Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operations and maintenance of the Canumay National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall make the necessary directive to effect the separation of Canumay Annex from the Valenzuela Municipal High School, as well as to bring about the smooth operation of the Canumay National High School under this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
